project: foldable storage box UGC closet rescue

source_video.role: local rhythm, camera movement, composition, action progression only; never upload or submit as reference_videos

segment_plan.seedance_plan: single storyboard and single Seedance task after approval

mother_with_baby.identity_lock: Malay Muslim woman, light pink hijab, cream knit cardigan, soft pink inner top, modest cream lower outfit, same face and hand details from reference
mother_with_baby.action_role: stands beside white wardrobe, holds baby with left arm, opens wardrobe with right hand, steps back when clothes fall
mother_with_baby.continuity: keeps baby securely against chest throughout all shots, remains in rear or side of frame after clothes collapse

helper.identity_lock: adult woman with shoulder-length brown wavy hair, gray fitted T-shirt, black straight jeans, white sneakers, same face/body proportions from reference
helper.action_role: is swept out with the clothes, lands in the pile, sits up, unfolds the storage box, loads clothes, closes zipper
helper.continuity: stays as the only active organizer after the closet spill, no maid costume, no racialized reference styling copied from source video

baby.identity_lock: small infant in simple white onesie and socks
baby.continuity: always held by the mother; never on the floor, never handling the product

product.identity_lock: foldable fabric storage box, square cube silhouette, gray-white horizontal stripe fabric, dark gray piping, dark gray handles, zippered top lid, soft but structured sides

states.start: not visible during closet problem setup
states.middle: opened upright on wood floor with lid folded back, handles visible, clothes being loaded inside
states.end: filled and zipped closed, front panel and zipper pull visible, compact cube form

product.fidelity_notes: preserve striped fabric pattern, gray edging, handles, zipper track, cube proportions, and open/closed states from product reference; do not redraw as black transparent box

environment.fixed_elements: white wardrobe with tall doors and long black handles, warm wood floor, white walls, nearby doorway and drawer unit
environment.prop_positions: wardrobe on right/back side, clothing pile spreads across floor center, storage box appears front-center after helper sits up
environment.screen_direction: wardrobe door opens toward viewer-left/front; clothes fall toward camera and floor center; organizing action happens front-center

lighting_and_camera.lighting: warm white indoor ceiling light, natural phone-camera exposure, mild shadows, no studio polish
lighting_and_camera.camera: vertical handheld phone video feeling, slight shake, mostly fixed position with small downward tilts and close push near product
lighting_and_camera.style: UGC home demo, realistic fabric and skin texture, casual but clean enough for ecommerce

cut_continuity.state: mother holds baby and reaches for wardrobe handle
wardrobe door opens and clothes bulge outward
clothes fall out and helper is carried out within the pile
helper lands on the clothing pile and braces with elbows

incoming_state: bedroom closet is closed; mother holds baby and stands ready to open wardrobe
outgoing_state: gray-white striped storage box is filled, zipped shut, and centered as final product proof
audio_direction: voiceover plus wardrobe/clothing rustle, zipper pull, floor movement, no background music by default
